articles.title: AI agent Poke makes setting up automations as easy as sending a text
articles.summary: Poke brings AI agents to everyday users via text message by handling tasks and automations without complex setup, apps, or technical know-how.

articles.title: AWS boss explains why investing billions in both Anthropic and OpenAI is an OK conflict
articles.summary: AWS has an ingrained culture of handling competition, he explained, because the cloud giant also competes with its partners.

articles.title: Tubi is the first streamer to launch a native app within ChatGPT
articles.summary: Tubi becomes the first streaming service to offer an app integration within ChatGPT, the AI chatbot that millions of users turn to for answers.

articles.title: Astropad’s Workbench reimagines remote desktop for AI agents, not IT support
articles.summary: Astropad’s Workbench lets users remotely monitor and control AI agents on Mac Minis from iPhone or iPad, with low-latency streaming and mobile access.

articles.title: OpenAI releases a new safety blueprint to address the rise in child sexual exploitation
articles.summary: OpenAI's new Child Safety Blueprint aims to tackle the alarming rise in child sexual exploitation linked to advancements in AI.

articles.title: Databricks co-founder wins prestigious ACM award, says ‘AGI is here already’
articles.summary: Matei Zaharia has won the top honor from the Association for Computing Machinery. Now he's working on AI for research and says AGI is simply misunderstood.

articles.summary: Confluence users can now create visual assets within the software in addition to new third-party agents working with Lovable, Replit, and Gamma.

articles.title: Google quietly launched an AI dictation app that works offline
articles.summary: Google's new offline-first dictation app uses Gemma AI models to take on the apps like Wispr Flow.

articles.title: I can’t help rooting for tiny open source AI model maker Arcee
articles.summary: Arcee is a tiny 26-person U.S. startup that built a high-performing, massive, open source LLM. And it's gaining popularity with OpenClaw users.

articles.title: Firmus, the ‘Southgate’ AI data center builder backed by Nvidia, hits $5.5B valuation

articles.title: Intel signs on to Elon Musk’s Terafab chips project
articles.summary: Intel will join SpaceX and Tesla in an effort to build a new U.S. semiconductor factory in Texas, although the scope of its contributions are unclear.

articles.title: Anthropic debuts preview of powerful new AI model Mythos in new cybersecurity initiative
articles.summary: The new model will be used by a small number of high-profile companies to engage in defensive cybersecurity work.

articles.title: Uber is the latest to be won over by Amazon’s AI chips
articles.summary: Uber is expanding its AWS contract to run more of its ride-sharing features on Amazon's chips. This is a thumb-of-the nose at Oracle and Google.

articles.title: Anthropic ups compute deal with Google and Broadcom amid skyrocketing demand
articles.summary: Anthropic bulked up its compute deal with Google and Broadcom as the company has seen its run-rate revenue surge to $30 billion.

articles.title: Google Maps can now write captions for your photos using AI
articles.summary: Google is rolling out new features to make it easier for users to contribute local knowledge to Maps. Most notably, Gemini can now create captions when users are looking to share a photo or video about a place.

articles.title: The AI gold rush is pulling private wealth into riskier, earlier bets
articles.summary: On a recent episode of Equity, we talked to Arena Private Wealth to explore a growing trend: family offices bypassing VCs to gain direct exposure to AI startups, turning them from passive investors into active participants.

articles.summary: Company acquires facility in Hemel Hempstead, Imagination set to remain a customer

articles.summary: Investors include NFX, TPY Capital, and Intel Capital

articles.title: Virginia grid utilization bill set to become law
articles.summary: A growing body of research suggests increased grid utilization has broad benefits for utilities and customers, but experts say advanced metering technology is needed to unlock its full potential.

articles.title: NERC is ‘actively monitoring the grid’ following Iran-linked cyber threat
articles.summary: Hackers have disrupted critical U.S. infrastructure by targeting programmable logic controllers, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency warned.

articles.title: Recalibrating the social license for AI infrastructure in the United States
articles.summary: To counter a public backlash, data center developers must embrace economic reciprocity while utilities and regulators must design rates that penalize grid stress and reward flexibility, write Fred Bailey of Gideon Arktos and Frank Willey at the Atlantic Council.

articles.title: Pennsylvania DEP seeks potential fast-track storage, generation projects
articles.summary: The request is in response to the PJM Interconnection’s proposed Expedited Interconnection Track, which faces opposition at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission from independent power producer Vistra and environmental groups.

articles.title: Energy storage pricing beginning to ‘fracture’ by product type: report
articles.summary: The split seems driven by battery developers supporting larger projects for data center and independent power producer clients, according to Anza Renewables.

articles.title: Commercial nuclear fuel recycling key to a sustainable supply: report
articles.summary: A robust recycling program could greatly reduce the volume and radiotoxicity of waste and reduce the need for additional uranium mining, according to the Energy Innovation Reform Project.

articles.title: Federal permitting is ‘outsized’ factor in clean energy delays, cancellations: Crux
articles.summary: “More than 80% of respondents reported intentionally siting projects to avoid triggering federal permitting requirements,” fintech company Crux said about its survey of clean energy developers.

articles.title: Turning the AC-DC switch: A legacy technology has reached its limits.
articles.summary: AC is no longer the preferred current for many applications. A transition is underway, but it calls for new technology to be deliberately deployed, writes Shaun Walsh at Peak Nano.

articles.title: Eversource, Avangrid ask FERC to stay $1.5B refund decision
articles.summary: The utility companies asked the agency to put a hold on a recent return on equity decision, saying consumers could be hurt by “rate whiplash” if the refunds are overturned in court.

articles.title: Greenhouse Gas Protocol changes can bring trust back to climate accounting
articles.summary: Common claims of 100% reliance on wind and solar are clearly at odds with the physical reality of companies’ electricity supply, writes Wilson Ricks at the Clean Air Task Force.

articles.title: Excavation work approved for India's Mahi Banswara units
articles.summary: India's Atomic Energy Regulatory Board has approved the start of activities towards excavation for construction of the Mahi Banswara Rajasthan Atomic Nuclear Power Project units 1 and 2.

articles.title: Containment tests completed at Sanmen 3
articles.summary: Tests to check the integrity of the containment structure have been completed at unit 3 of the Sanmen nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: In Pictures: Akkuyu 2's polar crane installed
articles.summary: The main part of the polar crane for unit 2 at Turkey's Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant been installed in position, at a height of 38.5 metres using a heavy-duty self-propelled crawler crane.

articles.title: Rooppur 1 boron flushes completed, ahead of fuel loading
articles.summary: Bangladesh's first nuclear power reactor has taken a fresh step towards starting up, after the successful completion of boron flushing of the first unit's primary circuit piping systems.

articles.title: Application lodged for Poland's first nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has submitted an application to Poland's National Atomic Energy Agency for a construction permit for the country's first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: South Africa's Necsa seeks SMR partnership
articles.summary: The South African Nuclear Energy Corporation has launched an Expression of Interest process which "aims to identify capable technology partners … to advance a fit-for-purpose SMR technology for future deployment".

articles.title: OPG applies for operating licence for BWRX-300 SMR
articles.summary: Canada's Ontario Power Generation has submitted its application for a licence to operate the first BWRX-300 small modular reactor at the Darlington New Nuclear Project.

articles.title: Belarus set for role in Smolensk nuclear construction
articles.summary: A working meeting requested by Smolensk Governor Vasily Anokhin has been held "to discuss the coordination of joint efforts and the participation of Belarusian partners in the Smolensk NPP-2 construction project".

articles.title: Reactor vessel installed at Lianjiang unit 2
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been installed at unit 2 of the Lianjiang nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province. It is one of two CAP1000 reactors planned for the first phase of the plant.

articles.title: Construction of second Jinqimen unit begins
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 2 at the Jinqimen nuclear power plant in Ningbo, Zhejiang province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. It is the second of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the plant.

articles.title: First criticality for Indian fast breeder reactor
articles.summary: The initiation of a controlled nuclear fission chain reaction at the Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor sees India move into the second stage of a three-stage nuclear programme which ultimately aims to achieve a closed fuel cycle using the country's abundant thorium.

articles.title: AMPERA, Scorpio team up for maritime microreactors
articles.summary: Monaco-based shipping company Scorpio Tankers Inc has entered into a strategic collaboration with AMPERA Inc of the USA to jointly develop and commercialise advanced microreactors for marine, shipping and related maritime applications.

articles.title: Singapore to bolster nuclear safety capabilities
articles.summary: Singapore's National Environment Agency said it will issue tenders to commission three studies on nuclear safety standards and environmental considerations as the island city-state studies the potential deployment of nuclear energy.

articles.title: Assessment completed of Chernobyl shelter repair works
articles.summary: The costs of repairing the damaged New Safe Confinement at the Chernobyl nuclear power plant in Ukraine will be "in the order of" EUR500 million (USD577 million), according to a preliminary technical assessment by Bouygues and Vinci.

articles.title: Taipower applies to restart Maanshan plant
articles.summary: Taiwan Power Company has submitted a plan to the Nuclear Safety Council for the restart of the Maanshan nuclear power plant, whose two units were taken offline in July 2024 and May 2025 following the expiry of their 40-year operating licences, in accordance with Taiwan's nuclear phase-out policy.

articles.title: Holtec SMR design clears key UK regulatory stage
articles.summary: Holtec International's SMR-300 small modular reactor design can potentially be built, operated and decommissioned in a manner that is safe and secure, UK regulators have concluded after the design completed Step 2 of the Generic Design Assessment.

articles.title: Korean reactor gets go-ahead to restart
articles.summary: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has been given approval by South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission to restart unit 2 at its Kori nuclear power plant, which has been offline since April 2023 when its original 40-year operating permit expired.

articles.title: Constellation seeks regulator's help for 2027 plant restart
articles.summary: Constellation Energy still expects to restart the Crane Clean Energy Center - formerly known as Three Mile Island unit 1 - in 2027 despite possible grid connection delays.

articles.title: Diablo Canyon receives licence renewals
articles.summary: Pacific Gas & Electric Co's two pressurised water reactors in Avila Beach, California are the 99th and 100th reactors to receive 20-year licence renewals from the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission, clearing them to operate until the mid-2040s.

articles.title: Westinghouse sets standards to support fleet-scale AP1000 deployment
articles.summary: Westinghouse Electric Company's submittal to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission seeks to incorporate lessons learned from the construction of Vogtle units 3 and 4 into the design control document and establishes Vogtle 4 as the standard AP1000 reference plant for deployment in the USA.
